scope: Calibration-3 instrumentation/protocol sanity gate. NOT a performance gate. Calibration is an instrumentation sanity check, not an opportunity to tune the method against performance.

checks.description: 3/3 requested calibration tasks executed under the intended protocol
checks.condition: n_records == 3 AND every record carries complete protocol metadata
per record: model identity, provider/route, temperature, agent-control cap, MAX_AGENT_CALLS, task_id all present and equal to the frozen values

checks.description: 3/3 valid final outputs OR failure explicitly classified
checks.condition: per task: valid_final_count > 0 OR empty_reason in (truncation, round_cap, parser_failure, infrastructure)
any record with malformed_count > 0 must have empty_reason == parser_failure
pricing preflight checks.no_drift is True AND every record's scientific model == qwen/qwen3-coder AND route contains deepinfra/turbo
every record's agent_control cap, temperature (0.0), and MAX_AGENT_CALLS (8) equal the frozen values
cumulative calibration USD <= frozen calibration ceiling (proportional share of the budget model's recommended ceiling) after the cumulative-USD guard

truncation_handling: Report exact cap-hit / truncation counts from the first-class telemetry. Use the frozen G2 cap rule. Do NOT invent a post-calibration cap change.
performance_rule: No F1-based calibration continuation rule is frozen. Calibration F1 alone MUST NOT tune or cancel the main experiment (mission section 24).
stop_trigger: The frozen pre-run protocol does not declare any cap hit/truncation as a stop trigger; cap hits during calibration are reported, not a stop trigger.
evaluation: scripts/wp1b_calibration_gate.py evaluates these checks against a calibration results directory (ZERO API, deterministic).
